extracted.intended_audience: University researchers/Principal Investigators and research administrators preparing FY2026 DoD MURI proposals to ONR
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and submitting white papers and full proposals to the Office of Naval Research (ONR) Multidisciplinary University Research Initiative (MURI) solicitation for FY2026, following the BAA requirements and deadlines. Includes use of standardized submission templates, compliance with conflict-of-interest policies, and alignment to DoD-relevant multidisciplinary basic research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support basic research at U.S. institutions
rubrics_metrics.description: The MURI program supports basic research in science and engineering at U.S. institutions of higher education (hereafter referred to as "universities").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed work should be basic research (science and engineering) and submitted by eligible U.S. institutions of higher education. See full announcement for any further eligibility details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevance to Department of Defense
rubrics_metrics.description: Research must be of potential interest to DoD.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Project scope and objectives should align with DoD interests and priorities identified in the solicitation; emphasize DoD relevance in the technical narrative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multidisciplinary focus
rubrics_metrics.description: The program is focused on multidisciplinary research efforts where more than one traditional discipline interacts to provide rapid advances in scientific areas of interest to the DoD.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assemble teams spanning multiple traditional disciplines with integrated interaction (not just parallel efforts) and demonstrate how multidisciplinary integration enables accelerated scientific advances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible applicant type (universities)
rubrics_metrics.description: U.S. institutions of higher education (hereafter referred to as 'universities') are the target participants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure applicant organization qualifies as a U.S. institution of higher education per solicitation definitions; institutional eligibility and lead/partner roles should conform to BAA rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of standardized technical and cost proposal templates
rubrics_metrics.description: Required: All BAAs incorporate a standardized template for the submission of technical and cost proposals for all contract awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Download and complete the provided standardized forms/spreadsheets for technical and cost proposals. Failure to use required templates may render a submission non-compliant.

rubrics_metrics.name: White paper submission deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: White Papers due no later than: May 02, 2025 5:00 PM EST
rubrics_metrics.guidance: White papers must be submitted by the stated date/time. Check the full announcement for submission method, formatting, and content requirements for white papers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full proposal submission deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Full Proposals will be accepted until: September 05, 2025 5:00 PM EST
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Full proposals must be submitted by the stated date/time. Confirm any proposal preparation windows, electronic submission system, and formatting/inclusion requirements in the full BAA document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of guidance and points of contact
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance and assistance in completing the form and spreadsheet can be obtained from points of contact provided in the BAA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use ONR-provided points of contact for questions about templates, submission procedures, and administrative requirements; document clarifications may be available via amendment or Q&A.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflicts of interest policy
rubrics_metrics.description: To ensure fairness in the consideration of proposals, ONR has implemented policies to protect against organizational conflicts of interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review and comply with ONR's organizational conflict of interest policies; identify and disclose potential COI per the solicitation instructions to avoid disqualification or restrictions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refer to full announcement and amendments
rubrics_metrics.description: Please see full text of the announcement for additional information. Documents: N0001425SF002.pdf and N0001425SF002_Amendment 1.pdf are provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The solicitation and its amendments contain full programmatic, eligibility, evaluation, submission, and contract terms. Consult those documents for complete evaluation criteria, proposal content requirements, and administrative instructions.
